 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay the two 4-row binary panels; mark occupied cells as 3."""
    split = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 4 for v in row)), None)
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("missing separator row")
    top, bottom = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom):
        raise ValueError("panels must have equal heights")
    return [[3 if a != 0 or b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(r1, r2)]
            for r1, r2 in zip(top, bottom)]
"
}
